<!--
  ideas are welcome, but keep them focused.
  "rewrite everything in X" is a discussion, not an issue :)
-->

### what's the problem?

<!-- describe the pain first, not the solution. the "why" matters most -->

### what would you like to see?

<!-- your proposed solution, rough sketches are fine -->

### alternatives you considered

<!-- other approaches, or "none" -->

### type

- [ ] ✨ new feature
- [ ] 🔧 refactor / restructure
- [ ] 📝 docs / tests / reliability
- [ ] 💄 styling / components / ui / ux

### accessibility

- [ ] this affects UI and needs a11y thought (keyboard, screen reader)
- [ ] N/A / no UI changes

### checklist

- [ ] i searched for existing issues
- [ ] i'm willing to work on this myself (optional, but appreciated!)
- [ ] this is genuinely one idea, not a wishlist
